reproduction: Independent clean local clone used the locked wheelhouse with package indexes disabled. ZIP, tarball and SHA256SUMS compared byte-for-byte identical.
workflow: After one-time Pi enrollment and trusted SSH, per-team dashboard Prepare and supported Home run the Pi CLI. A fresh standing cue still requires the connected Stop gamepad, and full Home attaches the runner. The standing robot reuses its session on End/Start. Terminal fallback and headless tests share the same implementation.

mac.scope: Fresh ZIP extraction, no previous venv, package index and pip cache disabled. Physical devices and robot discovery were not used.

linux_pi_archive.scope: ARM64/Jazzy Docker with network disabled, no checkout mount, actual Pi tarball extracted independently of the checkout. Compared every native source file against verified 7236bc6 tarball. No device or physical motion.

timing_extracted_releases.method: 8 alternating-order pairs, first excluded. Motor-inactive Prepare cold and warm plus Home launch-description construction, per benchmark_fc_prepare.py, from exact extracted previous and current archives in the same ARM64 ROS container. Each sample cold creates a fresh run and warm Prepare reuses it. Host load, cache and OS scheduling affect elapsed times. No robot processes started.
timing_extracted_releases.earlier_staging_study: A separate staged-candidate run in fc-runtime-path-20261120.json measured 47 ms cold Prepare saving. The exact archives measured 12.6 ms. Warm difference in both was about 0.1 ms.

physical_comparison: Previous Pi runs measured 8.19 and 10.66 s of qualification plus home, including 5.08 and 3.85 s mechanical. Healthy warm matches avoid repeating this procedure. Total user-intent-to-motion savings compared with the 609.8 s launch-to-first-request run require physical timing. The historical request may be zero.
ros_scope: Real local production lobby/field subprocess, UDP, DDS, executor and kick-handoff logic. The peer, guard feedback, camera and native kick completion are fixtures. Kickoff durations end at the first nonzero executor command.

isolated_setup.scope: Production Uvicorn, WebSockets, setup_session.open_setup argv, fc_session CLI/profile/run and real TTY supervised_stand code. Local SSH shim and pseudoterminal, fixture manager/process identity, native planner, board and Stop gateway. No radio or actuators.

camera_dropout: Three Linux/Jazzy native walker trials survived 1–3 s without front-camera detections. Walking-policy input went to zero at 276–298 ms. 1,064 zero native samples, stale sequence rejection, fresh clearance/zero/drive recovery to 0.16 m/s on the same walker generation. Core balance remains separately watched at 100 ms. See fc-runtime-path-20261120.json for individual results.

browser_fixture.scope: Real Chrome, production HTML/CSS/JS, localhost FastAPI, setup and play WebSockets and camera worker. Fixtures replace Pi processes, physical camera during play and field transport.
checks: Mobile 390px and 320px fit, Red setup can be opened and closed; Home requires explicit support.
Real synthetic camera worker delivered JPEG, six tags, both teams and ball; simulated camera cannot enable Start.
Blue Prepare and Home-only used one discovery, received confirmed Home and kept the runner disconnected.
Full Home waited for a fresh browser standing cue, sent one newline, then automatically attached the runner without rescanning.
Escape canceled Red’s pending standing cue and stopped the connected Blue adapter.
Blue keyboard / Red autonomous: W held before kickoff sent no forward drive, W in match drove Blue, End/Start twice maintained both sessions without another Home.

quick_regressions: 67 passed in 3.69 s with an upstream FastAPI TestClient deprecation warning. All three ROS rosters passed.
other_checks: 91 targeted native-launch, enrollment, session and staging tests with 10 additional subtests before the final disconnect correction. Final quick tests include corrected transport and Pi CLI regressions.

1,246 shared Gemini regression cases passed on the first broad run. Two HTTP-cache cases needed the existing legacy web/dist asset; all 40 HTTP transport tests passed with that development prerequisite present. The Pupper FC packages contain their own UI.

Rollback invoked from the exact shipped Pi tar restored and digest-verified the 79-file prior release across the selection change and disabled a first installation, repeatably; platform snapshots and native prefixes for rollback were fixtures.

model_review.implementation: Exact claude-opus-5-5 identified inherited recording-mode environment and insufficient staged runtime-import evidence. Stage verifies the default events/strict selection, and the extracted Pi observer was run in real ROS.
model_review.audit: Exact claude-fable-5-1 identified foreground interrupt propagation and early monitor exit. Final regressions cover Stop acknowledgement through a delayed ~550 ms completion, ROS cleanup and SSH child reaping. The PTY tests use synthetic Stop and no physical actuators.

physical_open: Measure cold time to first useful field motion and warm End/Start with real radio, Hailo and camera.
Confirm support, real gamepad Stop, actual braking/torque, feedback freshness, thermal behavior, and walking return after a kick on each robot.
A real core IMU dropout during motion remains a strict motor-disabling fault. Assisted recovery still requires support, an enrolled compatible driver and explicit intervention.

paired_timing_followup.scope: Single instrumented follow-up. Both field publishers were recreated. The paired fixture deliberately holds Red arm for 0.100 s. No intermediate timestamps were captured in the earlier 2.693 s warm sample, so its exact cause is unknown.
